result_summary.title: Upstream timeout affecting SSO Module in ME Production
result_summary.description: Users in the ME production region are experiencing login failures with the SSO Integration Module. The error logs indicate that requests to an upstream dependency are timing out. This is affecting approximately 912 users. We have also noted that the vendor status page for the upstream service is currently showing an active incident. We need to know if our configuration needs to be adjusted to handle these timeouts gracefully.

incidents.summary: Social Login Connector in ME is failing authentication requests for OAuth users.
